title: Revithia and Chickpea Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with revithia, chickpeas, and a hint of smokiness.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the revithia, chickpeas, paprika, and tomato paste. Stir to combine.
Pour in 4 cups of water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
